An astronaut on the International Space Station captured this photograph of Lake Pelku (near center) as the station orbited above Asia.

The International Space Station serves as a unique platform for observing Earth with both hands-on and automated equipment. Station crew members have produced hundreds of thousands of images. These images record phenomena in real time and support research and disaster relief.
